content.stem: 在准备可疑活动报告(SAR)时，哪些内容应提供给董事会或指定的专业委员会？

options.A: 报告期内提交的可疑活动报告(SAR)的统计数据
options.B: 报告期内提交的所有可疑活动报告（SAR）的全部详细信息

options.D: 报告期内所有被提交可疑活动报告(SAR)的客户姓名

content.stem_en: Which should be provided to the board of directors or designated specialized committee when preparing suspicious activity reports (SARs)?

options_en.B: All possible details of SARs filed during the reported period
options_en.C: Copies of all SARs filed during the reported period
options_en.D: Names of all customers subject to SARs filed during the reported period
